digest.component_or_area: completion-verification close gate (LLM agent loop guard and memo layer)
propositions: The runaway guard's outer layer position causes it to count memo-served (cached) repeats as loop evidence before the memo layer can serve them for free, defeating the memoization fix and triggering RunawayToolLoopError on legitimate completion-verification runs.

Completion-verification gate fails to close complete tickets because the guard and memo layers conflict in composition order: guard observes calls before memo can serve them from cache, so repeated file reads accumulate in the guard's distinct-ratio window and trip the runaway threshold.

A shared ToolCallLedger and two-arm guard (distinct-ratio over EXECUTED calls only, plus served-streak backstop for pure cache-served loops) must replace the in-file guard to separate memo-served repeats from genuine loop evidence.

The memo layer must record EXECUTED work at five sites (non-allowlisted passthrough, exact-sig miss, read_file first-read, path=None passthrough, truncated-window fallback) so the guard can distinguish model-generated harmless repeats from substantive tool loops.
